METALWORK — MOCK EXAM #14
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: METALWORK
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Centre La, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Centre La.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Centre La.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Centre La.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Centre La.

2. When learning Surface Finishing Processes, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Surface Finishing Processes.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Surface Finishing Processes.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Surface Finishing Processes.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Surface Finishing Processes.

3. When learning Assembly Drawings, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Assembly Drawings.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Assembly Drawings.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Assembly Drawings.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Assembly Drawings.

4. When learning Project 2, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Project 2.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Project 2.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Project 2.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Project 2.

5. When learning Forging, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Forging.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Forging.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Forging.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Forging.

6. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   B. Work alone with eyes closed
   C. Remove all guards
   D. Run with the tool

7. When learning Introduction to Computer Aided Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Computer Aided Drawing.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Computer Aided Drawing.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Computer Aided Drawing.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Computer Aided Drawing.

8. When learning Heat treatment of steel, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Heat treatment of steel.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Heat treatment of steel.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Heat treatment of steel.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Heat treatment of steel.

9. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Internal Cooking Timer
   B. Information and Communication Technology
   C. Input Cable Tester
   D. International Cricket Team

10. When learning Metalwork related businesses, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Metalwork related businesses.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Metalwork related businesses.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Metalwork related businesses.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Metalwork related businesses.

11. When learning Career Opportunities in Metalwork, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Career Opportunities in Metalwork.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Career Opportunities in Metalwork.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Career Opportunities in Metalwork.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Career Opportunities in Metalwork.

12. When learning Project 1, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Project 1.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Project 1.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Project 1.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Project 1.

13. When learning Gas Welding, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Gas Welding.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Gas Welding.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Gas Welding.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Gas Welding.

14. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   B. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   C. Ignore burnt cables
   D. Overload every socket

15. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Speaker
   B. Monitor
   C. CPU
   D. Keyboard

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Forging and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Surface Finishing Processes and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Project 2 and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Centre La and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

23. In three clear sentences, explain Project 1 and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
